battle.name: 西秦攻北涼之戰
battle.theater: 河西走廊中段（張掖、弱水下游）
battle.brief: 西秦建弘七年（426年），乞伏熾磐遣大將乞伏木郭干率步騎二萬西進，討北涼；北涼王沮渠牧犍遣弟安周前拒，大潰於河會，安周退保敦煌、酒泉自立為河西王，旋為西秦追破，北涼失河西西段。卡面羅馬標槍未隨軍而至，然西秦短標槍與北涼弓弩同屬先手投射、壓制盾陣的戰技。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 西秦攻北涼之戰爆發於公元426年，交戰雙方是據隴西的西秦與據涼州的北涼。西秦為鮮卑乞伏氏所建，首都枹罕（河州治所，今甘肅臨夏），國主乞伏熾磐自412年即位，先改元永康，後改建弘；其疆域為隴西、金城、河州之地，仿漢制置官，設大將軍、大單于與諸州牧，兵制以鮮卑騎兵為骨幹，漢人步兵與氐、羌、吐谷渾等部眾為輔，馬兵善射，步戰則倚賴長矛與弓弩。北涼是沮渠氏在涼州建立的政權，沮渠蒙遜奠基，時王沮渠牧犍以姑臧（涼州治所，今甘肅武威）為都，治涼州、張掖、酒泉、敦煌三郡之地；其軍府以漢地士人為骨，涼州胡族騎兵為翼，靠屯田與城寨自給，兵精而地險，名義上則奉劉宋正朔。四二六年的接觸並非兩國王對王的正面交鋒：北涼內部沮渠安周與其兄牧犍交惡，起兵自立並拉攏敦煌、酒泉一帶的漢地豪族，西秦則乘隙西進。戰線自弱水下游的河會一路向東，延伸到酒泉與敦煌兩郡。
countriesEn: The war in which Western Qin attacked Northern Liang broke out in 426 CE. The two sides were Western Qin, holding Longxi, and Northern Liang, holding Liangzhou. Western Qin had been founded by the Xianbei Qifu clan. Its capital was Fuhan, the seat of Hezhou in what is now Linxia in Gansu, and its ruler was Qifu Chipan, who had taken the throne in 412, first under the era name Yongkang and later under Jianhong. His territory covered Longxi, Jincheng and Hezhou. The state copied Han institutions, appointing a General-in-Chief, a Great Chanyu and governors of commanderies, and built its army on Xianbei cavalry, with Han infantry and contingents of Di, Qiang and Tuyuhun in support: the horsemen were skilled with the bow, while the foot relied on long spears and crossbows. Northern Liang had been founded in Liangzhou by the Juqu clan, the founder being Juqu Mengxun; the ruler at this time was Juqu Mujian, Prince of Hexi, whose capital at Guzang, the seat of Liangzhou in what is now Wuwei in Gansu, governed the lands of the three commanderies Liangzhou, Zhangye, Jiuquan and Dunhuang. Its army was organised around Han gentry officers, with Liangzhou Xiongnu horsemen on the wings, and it supported itself by farming and by fortified posts; its troops were well drilled in a country of strong natural defences, while in name it acknowledged the legitimacy of the Liu Song court. What happened in 426 was not a set-piece clash between two kings. Inside Northern Liang, Juqu Anzhou had fallen out with his brother Mujian, rose in revolt and drew over the Han landowners of Dunhuang and Jiuquan; Western Qin moved west into the gap. The front ran from the meeting on the Ruoshui at Hehui eastward as far as the two commanderies of Jiuquan and Dunhuang.
people: 西秦主乞伏熾磐即西秦文昭王，廟號太祖，勇略過人，393年被立為太子；西秦第一次亡國時他被送往南涼為質，402年自南涼奔後秦與父親乾歸會合，409年西秦復國再被立為太子，412年乾歸為姪乞伏公府所弒，熾磐領兵擒殺公府而即位，稱大將軍、河南王，改元永康；413年攻吐谷渾，414年攻陷樂都、滅南涼，復稱秦王，此後主要與北涼爭鬥，415年破北涼湟河之眾，424年在臨松擒獲北涼將領沮渠白蹄，428年病死。統兵西征的是乞伏木郭干，西秦名將，屢領步騎出戰河西，其後又率軍攻取南涼都城姑臧，南涼因此在433年前後覆亡。北涼方面，坐鎮姑臧的是河西王沮渠牧犍，沮渠蒙遜之子，寬厚而失殺，晚年寵信其弟安周，遂生內禍；四二六年前出的正是安周，他自稱河西王，麾下有張鐵、張檀等部將，與敦煌一帶的漢地豪族往來。北涼陣中另有被俘的沮渠白蹄等將領。此役的詳細兵力、斬獲與俘虜數，各史所載互有出入，只宜取其大略。
peopleEn: The ruler of Western Qin, Qifu Chipan, was the Prince Wenzhao of that state, posthumously given the temple name Taizu, and was a man of unusual boldness and resource. He was made crown prince in 393. When Western Qin was first destroyed he was sent to Southern Liang as a hostage, and in 402 he fled from Southern Liang to Later Qin and rejoined his father, Qifu Qianguí; when Western Qin was restored in 409 he was made crown prince once more. In 412 Qianguí was murdered by his nephew Qifu Gongfu, and Chipan took the field, captured Gongfu and put him to death, then mounted the throne as General-in-Chief and Prince of Henan, changing the era to Yongkang. In 413 he campaigned against the Tuyuhun; in 414 he took Ledu, destroyed Southern Liang and resumed the title Prince of Qin; from then on his wars were mainly with Northern Liang, breaking the Northern Liang forces at the Huanghe in 415 and, in 424, capturing the Northern Liang commander Juqu Baidi at Linsong. He died in 428. The commander who led the western expedition was Qifu Mugua'gan, a famous general of Western Qin who repeatedly led foot and horse into Hexi and who was later to take the Southern Liang capital of Guzang, bringing Southern Liang to its end in the years around 433. On the Northern Liang side, the man who held Guzang was Juqu Mujian, Prince of Hexi, a son of Juqu Mengxun, generous to the point of slackness, who late in his reign favoured his brother Anzhou and so let an internal disaster grow. The man who came forward in 426 was Anzhou himself, who proclaimed himself Prince of Hexi, with such commanders as Zhang Tie and Zhang Tan under him and connections to the Han landowners of Dunhuang. Among the Northern Liang officers taken prisoner was Juqu Baidi. The detailed figures for the strength of the armies, for the killed and for the captives differ from source to source, and only the broad outline should be taken from them.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬標槍（pilum）是羅馬軍團的重投射兵器，約公元前100年前後定型：槍身為中空木桿，前接細長的金屬槍頭，全長約半米，擲出時靠前端配重取得射程，撞上盾牌即折斷留在盾面，敵兵無法持盾前進，只能棄盾或連盾帶槍退回掩體。羅馬以密集拋擲鋪滿敵陣之前的地面，逼敵散陣，這就是它被列為單獨兵種的原因。西秦與北涼的裝備屬漢晉邊地軍制，與之功能相當的正是短標槍與弓弩：西秦騎兵用短標槍在馳射中投射步戰，北涼弓弩手在城頭與陣前列射，弩以機關蓄力，射程遠過步弓，兩軍都靠大盾與札甲抵擋飛矢。西秦另備長矛、長柄刀、鐵鏃箭與披甲戰馬，攻城用雲梯、撞車與飛樓；北涼的補給靠酒泉、敦煌的屯田出糧，再以牛車沿走廊輸送。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card, the Roman pilum, was the heavy missile of the Roman legion and took its form around 100 BC. Its shaft was a hollow shaft of wood carrying a long thin metal head; the whole weapon was about half a metre long, and in throwing it gained its range from the weight at the front end. Struck against a shield it broke off and stayed in the shield, so that the man holding the shield could not advance and had either to abandon it or to withdraw behind his cover with the broken shaft still standing in it. Rome used dense volleys to carpet the ground in front of an enemy line and force the enemy to break formation, and that is why it was ranked as a separate arm. The equipment of Western Qin and Northern Liang belonged to the Han and Jin frontier military system, and the functional counterparts of the pilum there were the short throwing javelin and the bow and crossbow. The Xianbei horsemen of Western Qin threw short javelins at the enemy foot while riding; the archers and crossbowmen of Northern Liang shot from the tops of towers and from the front of the line, and the crossbow stored its power in a mechanism, giving it a range far beyond that of the ordinary bow; both sides met flying arrows with large shields and lamellar armour. Western Qin also carried long spears, long-handled sabres, iron-tipped arrows and armoured warhorses, and used scaling ladders, battering rams and wooden towers in sieges. Northern Liang drew its supplies from the farms of Jiuquan and Dunhuang, whose grain was carried along the corridor on ox carts.
tactics: 西秦的戰法是鮮卑式的野戰節奏。乞伏木郭干領步騎二萬自枹罕方向西進，渡弱水，直取北涼在張掖一帶的前哨與糧道，兩軍在河會相遇。西秦先以弓弩與短標槍覆蓋，把北涼的盾陣壓在原地，再以騎兵大縱隊迂迴其側翼，最後衝陣；這與羅馬標槍覆蓋加縱隊衝鋒的邏輯同源，只是投射兵種換成了弓弩與短標槍。北涼則以城寨與屯堡為依托，令安周前出拒守，想用熟悉的水源與道路拖住遠來的客軍；但北涼重裝步騎一旦離開城寨，展開空間受限，而河會一帶多沙磧與鹽鹼地，利騎兵衝鋒而不利重裝行列。戰敗之後安周退保敦煌、酒泉，據城自守；西秦不與之久拖，遠程奔襲其乾旱而單薄的補給線，圍城斷糧，最終在城下的野戰中再破叛軍，安周眾叛親離。整場戰爭的關鍵，在於誰能控制弱水與酒泉之間的補給段，以及誰能讓騎兵在水源之間快速機動。
tacticsEn: The way Western Qin fought was the steppe rhythm of open battle. Qifu Mugua'gan led some twenty thousand foot and horse westward from the direction of Fuhan, crossed the Ruoshui and struck straight at the outposts and the supply route of Northern Liang around Zhangye; the two armies met at Hehui. Western Qin first covered the ground with bows, crossbows and short javelins, pinning the Northern Liang shield-wall in place, then sent its cavalry in deep columns to roll up the flank, and attacked at last. The logic is the same as that of the Roman pilum followed by a charging column; only the missile troops were different, bows, crossbows and short javelins in place of the pilum. Northern Liang relied on forts and on its stockaded posts, and sent Anzhou forward to refuse the approach, hoping to wear down a distant army with the local roads and waters. But as soon as Northern Liang's heavily equipped foot and horse left the shelter of its forts they had little room to deploy, and the ground about Hehui is sandy and saline: good for a cavalry charge, bad for a close-order line. After the defeat Anzhou fell back on Dunhuang and Jiuquan and held the cities. Western Qin did not sit down before them; it struck by long march at the dry, thin supply line, surrounded the cities and cut the grain, and finally broke the rebels again in the field below the walls, at which point Anzhou was abandoned by his own men. The hinge of the whole war was who could hold the supply segment between the Ruoshui and Jiuquan, and who could move cavalry quickly between the water sources.
data: 可核對的數字有限，但有幾條在傳世記載中相當一致。其一，西秦出兵的規模記作「步騎二萬」，《晉書》與《資治通鑑》兩書所記相若；其二，公元426年為西秦建弘七年，正是其西征北涼之年；其三，前一年建弘五年（424年）西秦在臨松擒獲北涼將領沮渠白蹄，出自同一位主帥、同一戰區，可見河西一線的拉鋒自424年即已展開，河會之戰是這條戰線上的正面撞擊。數字最不可靠的部分是斬獲與被俘：河會一役兩軍的斬首數與俘獲數各家記載互有出入，可以確定的只是安周所部由整建主力崩解，再無力野戰。距離上，枹罕至張掖的直線距離約三百公里，騎兵急行軍需十數日，糧秣多靠沿途屯田與徵發；敦煌自西晉末以來屢經前涼、北涼經營，是河西最富的郡，糧源與戶口正是西秦西進的目標，也是北涼不能輕棄它的原因。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, but a few are given with fair consistency in the transmitted records. First, the size of the Western Qin force is given as twenty thousand foot and horse, and the Jin Shu and the Zizhi Tongjian agree closely on it. Second, 426 CE was the seventh year of Jianhong under Western Qin, the very year of its westward campaign against Northern Liang. Third, in the year before, in the fifth year of Jianhong, 424 CE, Western Qin had captured the Northern Liang commander Juqu Baidi at Linsong; that came from the same commander in the same theatre, so the contest along the Hexi line had already begun in 424, and the battle at Hehui was the frontal collision on that line. The least reliable numbers are the killed and the captured: the figures for heads taken and prisoners taken at Hehui differ from source to source, and the only thing certain is that Anzhou's command dissolved as an organised force and could no longer fight in the open. As for distance, the straight line from Fuhan to Zhangye is about three hundred kilometres, a hard ride of more than ten days for cavalry, and the grain came mainly from the farms along the route and from requisition. Dunhuang, farmed in turn by Former Liang and by Northern Liang since the end of the Western Jin, was the richest commandery of Hexi; its grain and its registered households were both the object of the Western Qin advance and the reason Northern Liang could not lightly give it up.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。第一層是地緣：西秦在隴西站穩之後必然要取河西，北涼據涼州與河西三郡，扼住從關中通往西域的咽喉，誰控制酒泉與敦煌，誰就控制西北的馬匹、鐵料與商路；西秦要在與後秦、吐谷渾的角力中取得資源，也要先解決背後的北涼。第二層是北涼的內部裂痕被利用：沮渠牧犍對其弟安周縱容而失察，兄弟交惡，安周在涼州不得志，轉而拉攏敦煌、酒泉一帶的漢地豪族並自立為河西王，君臣由此互相猜忌，涼州防務為之內虛。第三層是戰略窗口：424年西秦在臨松擒沮渠白蹄，已在河西站穩腳跟；425年北涼內亂的消息傳出，西秦立即集中兵力西進。根本原因則是十六國後期河西走廊的權力真空：前涼早亡，前秦崩潰，南涼被西秦所滅，北魏在北方整合，十六國中仍有條件爭河西的只剩北涼，而北涼自己的統治並不牢固。
causeEn: There are three layers to the reasons for the war. The first is geography. Once Western Qin had made itself secure in Longxi it had to reach for Hexi; Northern Liang held Liangzhou and the three commanderies of Hexi and gripped the throat of the road from Guanzhong to the western regions, and whoever held Jiuquan and Dunhuang held the horses, the iron and the trade of the north-west. If Western Qin was to get resources in the competition with Later Qin and the Tuyuhun, it had to settle the Northern Liang behind it first. The second layer is that the internal fracture of Northern Liang was exploited: Juqu Mujian indulged his brother Anzhou and failed to watch him, the two brothers fell out, Anzhou had no standing at Liangzhou, turned instead to win over the Han landowners of Dunhuang and Jiuquan and proclaimed himself Prince of Hexi, and from that moment ruler and ministers mistrusted one another and the defence of Liangzhou was hollow from within. The third layer is the strategic opening: in 424 Western Qin had taken Juqu Baidi at Linsong and already had a footing in Hexi; when word of the Northern Liang trouble reached Western Qin in 425, the army moved west at once. At the root of it all lies the vacuum along the Hexi corridor in the later years of the Sixteen Kingdoms: Former Liang had long fallen, Former Qin had collapsed, Southern Liang had been destroyed by Western Qin, the Northern Wei were consolidating in the north, and of all the Sixteen Kingdoms only Northern Liang was still in a position to contest Hexi, and Northern Liang's own rule was not secure.
impact: 影響是多層的。政治上，西秦藉此把勢力推入河西走廊西段，敦煌、酒泉兩郡的郡兵與屯田先後易手，河西的格局由北涼獨佔變成西秦與北涼在走廊上拉鋒；北涼雖保住姑臧與張掖的核心，卻失去敦煌這座最富的郡，國力由盛轉衰，最終在439年被北魏大軍吞滅。對西秦自身，這場勝利是短暫的：乞伏氏內部在428年已因宮廷變故而凋零，431年西秦亡於赫連勃勃建立的夏國，河西隨即出現真空，最後由北魏填補。戰術層面的意義更為持久：十六國北方的戰爭方式在這一戰中完成一次演進，騎兵為主的野戰、投射兵器先手覆蓋、城寨與屯田互相依存的補給體系，都被集中檢驗；胡族騎兵與漢地屯田兵如何編在同一支軍隊裡，遠來的客軍在缺水地區如何靠速度取勝，都留下可供後人比對的戰例。涼州一帶的儒學與譯業也在戰亂中屢受折損，胡漢聚落的往來隨之收縮。
impactEn: The effects worked on several levels. Politically, Western Qin pushed its power into the western section of the Hexi corridor; the garrisons and the farms of the two commanderies of Dunhuang and Jiuquan changed hands, and the balance of Hexi turned from a Northern Liang monopoly into a contest between Western Qin and Northern Liang along the corridor. Northern Liang kept the core of Guzang and Zhangye but lost Dunhuang, the richest of its commanderies, and its strength went from ascent to decline, ending in 439 when the Northern Wei swallowed it. For Western Qin itself the victory was short-lived. The Qifu clan was already withering from palace feuds in 428, and in 431 Western Qin was destroyed by the state of Xia founded by Helian Bobo; a vacuum then opened over Hexi, and in the end the Northern Wei filled it. The more lasting significance lies at the tactical level. The way war was fought in the northern Sixteen Kingdoms went through a stage of its evolution in this campaign: open battle led by cavalry, missile troops covering the enemy before the charge, and a supply system in which forts and farms depended on one another were all tested at once. How Xianbei horsemen and Han farming soldiers were woven into a single army, and how a distant invading host won in a waterless country by speed alone, left behind engagements that later generations could set side by side and compare. The Confucian learning and the translation work of the Liang region also suffered repeated damage in the wars, and the intercourse between Chinese and non-Chinese settlements drew in.
result: 結果以西秦的攻勢勝利告終。公元426年夏，乞伏木郭干率步騎二萬與北涼安周所部戰於河會，北涼前軍潰散，安周與部將張鐵、張檀等退入敦煌，自稱河西王，據酒泉、敦煌兩郡與西秦對抗；西秦隨即再發大軍追討，叛軍在城下的野戰中再敗，安周眾叛親離，殘部西走，其後在張掖一帶為部下所殺，首級送於西秦。河西走廊西段自此歸西秦所有，敦煌、酒泉的郡兵、屯田與戶口盡為西秦所得；北涼保住涼州治所姑臧與張掖，卻自此元氣大傷，失了最重要的一郡與一支能戰的騎兵。但勝利未能持久：西秦在428年內訌耗盡元氣，429年尚能再出兵步騎二萬攻河西，431年卻被赫連夏所滅；北涼又撐了十三年，到439年終於在北魏鐵騎之下覆亡，河西走廊重新歸於中原王朝。
resultEn: The result was a Western Qin victory in the offensive. In the summer of 426, Qifu Mugua'gan led some twenty thousand foot and horse into battle against the troops of Anzhou of Northern Liang at Hehui; the forward command of Northern Liang broke up, and Anzhou, with such commanders as Zhang Tie and Zhang Tan, retired into Dunhuang, proclaimed himself Prince of Hexi and set up in the two commanderies of Jiuquan and Dunhuang against Western Qin. Western Qin then sent out its army again; the rebels were beaten a second time in the field below the walls, Anzhou was abandoned by his own men, and his remnants moved west, where he was later killed by his own followers in the neighbourhood of Zhangye and his head was sent to Western Qin. The western section of the Hexi corridor now belonged to Western Qin, and the garrisons, the farms and the registered households of Dunhuang and Jiuquan went with it. Northern Liang kept Guzang, the seat of Liangzhou, and Zhangye, but it was left badly weakened, deprived of its richest commandery and of a body of cavalry that could still fight. Yet the victory did not last. Western Qin spent itself in the palace feuds of 428; it could still send twenty thousand foot and horse against Hexi in 429, but it was destroyed by the Xia of Helian Bobo in 431. Northern Liang held on for thirteen more years and at last went down before the Northern Wei cavalry in 439, when the Hexi corridor returned to a Chinese dynasty.
